name: PubMed Central / Europe PMC open full texts
publisher_org: US National Library of Medicine / EMBL-EBI
notes: PubMed Central (NIH/NLM) is live and describes itself as 'a free full-text archive of biomedical and life sciences journal literature' with 12.6 million articles, confirming open full-text access. The homepage carries no blanket licence statement: deposit/licence arrangements differ per journal and per article, so per-article CC/OA licence terms must be checked on each article page - consistent with the record's 'varies (OA licences)'. Evidence: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov (read 2026-11-13)
